description:
At Crossing Hurdles, we work as a referral partner. We refer candidates to Mercor that collaborates with the world’s leading AI research labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.

**Organization:**
Mercor

**Position:**
Senior Software Engineer

**Referral Partner:**
Crossing Hurdles

**Type:**
Hourly Contract

**Compensation:**
$100–$200/hour

**Location:**
Remote

**Commitment:**
10–40 hours/week

**Role Responsibilities (Training support will be provided)**

- Work on real-world programming tasks including debugging, refactoring, and writing test cases for complex codebases.
- Review and improve large-scale repositories across multiple languages.
- Contribute high-quality engineering input to support AI research and model training.
- Collaborate asynchronously with research teams to ensure accuracy, performance, and maintainability.

**Requirements**

- Strong experience in software engineering across languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Go, and C#.
- Strong experience working on complex production systems or large-scale open-source projects.
- Excellent problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

**Application process (Takes 20 min)**

- Upload resume
- AI interview based on your resume (15 min)
- Submit form
title: Python Developer | $200/hr Remote | Mercor
